statement: Get returns ErrClosed when the pool's idle channel snapshot is nil (after Release).
Get first tries a non-blocking receive of an idle connection from the idle channel.
An idle connection whose last-return time plus IdleTimeout lies before now is treated as expired.
Get closes an expired idle connection via Close and ignores Close's return value.
Get reads the ping function field without holding the mutex.
When Ping is configured, Get pings an idle connection and discards it on error.
Get acquires the mutex only after the non-blocking receive found no idle connection.
Get tests whether the open-connection count reached MaxCap before it tests whether the pool was released.
At capacity, Get appends a new request channel to the waiter queue without any bound on the queue length.
A waiting Get blocks on its request channel with no timeout and no cancellation.
A waiting Get returns ErrMaxActiveConnReached only if its request channel is closed.
A connection handed to a waiter is checked only for expiry, not with Ping.
Get calls the user factory while it still holds the mutex.
A factory error is returned to the Get caller unwrapped, without retry and without changing the open-connection count.
After a successful factory call Get increments the open-connection count, even if the returned connection is nil.
Put rejects a nil connection with an error.
Put on a released pool calls Close on the connection and returns its result.
When a waiter exists, Put hands the connection to the oldest waiter instead of storing it.
A connection handed to a waiter gets a fresh timestamp at the time of the Put.
Without waiters, Put stores the connection in the idle channel with a fresh timestamp, without checking whether it came from this pool or is already stored.
When the idle channel is full, Put closes the connection via Close.
Close rejects a nil connection with an error.
Close returns nil without calling any close function when the close function field is nil, which is the case after Release.
Close decrements the open-connection count unconditionally for any non-nil value and signals no waiting Get.
Close calls the user close function while holding the mutex (the unlock is deferred).
The exported Ping method calls the ping function without checking that it is non-nil.
Release sets the idle channel field to nil under the mutex.
Release sets the ping function field to nil under the mutex.
Release sets the close function field to nil, so later Close calls cannot close connections.
Release does not touch the waiter queue or wake waiting Gets before unlocking.
A second Release returns immediately.
Release closes each idle connection with the saved close function outside the mutex and ignores its errors.
Len returns the number of idle connections only, taking the mutex through getConns.
NewChannelPool accepts MaxCap equal to 0 as long as InitialCap <= MaxIdle <= MaxCap and InitialCap >= 0.
If the factory fails while filling InitialCap connections, NewChannelPool releases the pool and returns an error.
The struct declares a waitTimeOut field.
